scope: Retrospective diagnosis of frozen v1, not model selection or a new independent TEST. No v1 input, weight or metric is replaced.

limits: GT arrays are not loaded. Intersections are checked algebraically, not independently remeasured.
Matching counts/identities do not prove anatomical alignment, annotation correctness or absence of model bugs.
No training, inference, model selection, prediction modification or new test claim occurs.

native_cache.visual_review: All twelve three-plane panels reviewed. No obvious relative image/label misalignment, mirror, axis swap or wrong-case appearance on shown slices. Not full-volume anatomical ground-truth or identity certification.
limits: Agreement verifies consistency of two implementations of the declared preprocessing, not anatomical correctness of native labels.
A raw-mask centroid projected into the cache need not equal the decimated mask centroid; nearest-neighbour sampling changes boundary occupancy.
Hard invariants exclude resampler exact-equality checks and centroid differences; a false exact comparison can result from nearest-neighbour ties rather than physical misregistration.
Native GT maximum-area planes are fixed independently of predictions. The nearest cached plane can differ by up to half a cached index; inspect recorded rounding offsets.
M015 was selected after observing failures; these are retrospective diagnostics, not a new held-out evaluation or proof of an acquisition/domain shift.
No model, predictions, frozen protocol, cache arrays or manifest are modified.

interpretation: The specified count/aggregation, resampling and direct inference checks found no actionable discrepancy. They do not prove all code is correct, exclude training-time AMP sensitivity, certify anatomical annotations, or identify why M015 fails. Position/FOV and raw intensity remain hypotheses with counterevidence, not established causes.
